reason: Having been burned by Jamku and desktop tools that my staff abandoned after two months, I cannot risk granting Google Drive access to an external software that might expose our firm's confidential files. In a normal week, I would only ever test the free sandbox on a few dummy clients rather than paying ₹12,990 upfront.
objection: Will connecting my Google Drive give Docketra access to read all my firm's private files?
would_change_my_mind: A trusted peer recommendation from my local ICAI study circle and verifiable proof on Google's OAuth consent screen that permissions are strictly limited to files created by the app.
